item.text:
**Bottom Line**  
Lula’s 2024 record shows substantial, but not clean, mobilization capacity. He was able to push a large bureaucratic and budgetary program through planning instruments, line ministries, social programs, police/federal operations, and some coalition bargains. The main weaknesses were fiscal credibility, cabinet discipline, and interference in strategic economic institutions.

**Evidence For**
- **PPA 2024-2027: six priorities, 88 programs, budget linkage**  
  Publisher: Ministry of Planning and Budget  
  Date: December 19, 2024  
  URL: https://www.gov.br/planejamento/pt-br/assuntos/planejamento/plano-plurianual/paginas/paginas-ppa-2024-2027/ppa-2024-2027-english  
  Claim: Lula’s core program was translated into a formal four-year plan with priorities, programs, and monitoring tied to annual budgets. This is strong evidence of bureaucratic mobilization around the chosen program.  
  IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `8B.1`

- **Novo PAC selection package, R$23 billion in health/education/culture**  
  Publisher: Ministry of Culture  
  Date: March 7, 2024  
  URL: https://www.gov.br/cultura/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/novo-pac-selecoes-investe-r-23-bilhoes-em-saude-educacao-esporte-e-cultura/  
  Claim: The government moved large-scale spending through line ministries, with 6,778 works/equipment and explicit sectoral targeting. This shows Lula’s apparatus could mobilize around priority delivery.  
  IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`

- **Bolsa Família decree with conditionalities and monitoring**  
  Publisher: Presidency of the Republic / Planalto  
  Date: June 17, 2024  
  URL: https://www.presidencia.gov.br/Ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12064.htm  
  Claim: Lula tied the flagship welfare program to health/education conditionalities, shared monitoring, and administrative rules. That is evidence of disciplined bureaucratic mobilization, not just rhetoric.  
  IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`

- **SNAVE school-violence system**  
  Publisher: Presidency of the Republic / Planalto  
  Date: April 24, 2024  
  URL: https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12006.htm  
  Claim: Lula created a standing national monitoring-and-response system for school violence. This shows the presidency can build targeted enforcement architecture and coordinate across agencies.  
  IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`

- **Yanomami anti-garimpo operations**  
  Publisher: Ministry of Indigenous Peoples  
  Date: July 16, 2024  
  URL: https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/07/governo-federal-completa-mil-operacoes-realizadas-na-terra-indigena-yanomami-no-periodo-de-cinco-meses  
  Claim: The government reported 1,000 operations in five months against illegal mining, coordinated through federal structures. This is one of the clearest examples of mobilizing the security apparatus toward a policy objective.  
  IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`

- **Technocratic central-bank appointment with autonomy pledge**  
  Publisher: Reuters via Investing.com  
  Date: August 28, 2024; October 8, 2024  
  URL: https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-to-nominate-galipolo-as-cenbank-chief-says-finance-minister-3591764  
  Claim: Lula chose a serving central-bank monetary policy director and later guaranteed him decision-making freedom. That supports a reading of selective, competence-based personnel mobilization.  
  IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `7B.9`

- **Coalition got fiscal package through Congress**  
  Publisher: Reuters via ThePrint  
  Date: December 21, 2024  
  URL: https://theprint.in/world/brazils-congress-passes-fiscal-package-government-plays-down-changes-to-the-measures/2413876/  
  Claim: Congress approved most of Lula’s fiscal package, indicating he could still mobilize legislative support for medium-term fiscal repair.  
  IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`

**Evidence Against**
- **Central-bank pressure weakened technocratic coordination**  
  Publisher: Reuters via UOL  
  Date: July 1, 2024  
  URL: https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/01/lula-critica-bc-autonomo-e-diz-que-autoridade-monetaria-nao-atende-populacao.htm  
  Claim: Lula publicly pressured the central bank to follow his preferred macro view. This suggests that mobilization of the economic apparatus was real but also politically noisy and partially destabilizing.  
  IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `8B.1`

- **Petrobras dividend interference**  
  Publisher: Reuters via UOL  
  Date: March 18, 2024; March 20, 2024  
  URL: https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/18/ministerio-publico-do-tcu-pede-investigacao-de-possivel-interferencia-do-governo-na-petrobras.htm  
  Claim: Reuters and the TCU prosecutor pointed to possible government interference in Petrobras’ dividend decision. This is strong evidence that Lula could mobilize state-linked firms for political priorities, but also that the process looked discretionary.  
  IDs: `8B.3`, `7B.9`, `7B.10`

- **Indicted minister not removed immediately**  
  Publisher: Reuters via UOL  
  Date: June 12, 2024; June 13, 2024  
  URL: https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/12/ministro-das-comunicacoes-e-indiciado-pela-pf-por-corrupcao-em-investigacao-sobre-desvio-na-codevasf-dizem-fontes.htm  
  Claim: Lula did not immediately dismiss a cabinet minister indicted in a public-works corruption probe. That weakens the claim that the coalition/ruling network was being aligned cleanly around the program.  
  IDs: `8B.3`, `7B.9`, `7B.10`

- **Fiscal credibility problems limited policy control**  
  Publisher: Reuters via Investing.com  
  Date: September 18, 2024; September 20, 2024; November 5, 2024  
  URL: https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisbrazils-tinkering-to-meet-fiscal-target-threatens-to-dent-credibility-3620814  
  Claim: Reuters reported increasingly creative accounting, spending freezes, and possible cuts to health/education. This shows Lula’s apparatus could not fully discipline macro execution around the chosen program.  
  IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`

**Assessment**
- **Yes, mostly**: Lula had real mobilization capacity in 2024, especially through budgeting, welfare administration, environmental enforcement, school-violence coordination, and anti-garimpo operations.
- **But imperfectly**: the coalition and economic team were not fully aligned, and strategic economic institutions showed recurring friction.
- **Search gap**: I found much stronger evidence for bureaucratic and budgetary mobilization than for direct party-machine or military command mobilization. The military evidence is mainly indirect and bounded, such as election-security deployment and formal security operations rather than a broad military-political coalition.
